# A boundary html renders from code rather than markup: under a reactive `if`,
# inside a slot a component inserts there, and in the body of a component
# built at run time. Each reached codegen as an *ir.ErrorBoundary among the
# flat statements of a render function and panicked irwalk, which has no arm
# for one. A raise finds its handler through the call, so by then the boundary
# is its children; each case here raises on mount and the handler records it.

[!chromium] skip 'the rendered DOM needs a real Chromium'

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'
grep '<span>inside slot</span>' app.sngl.snapshots/slot.html
grep '<span>a card</span>' app.sngl.snapshots/instance.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { none { html } }

component Panel(content ...component node) node {
    vbox {
        content
    }
}

component underIf node {
    var show = true
    var caught = ""

    vbox {
        if show {
            vbox {
                boundary(@error(e) { caught = e.message }) {
                    text(value="inside if")
                    effect(@mount { error.raise("if", "") })
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

component inSlot node {
    var show = true
    var caught = ""

    vbox {
        if show {
            Panel {
                boundary(@error(e) { caught = e.message }) {
                    text(value="inside slot")
                    effect(@mount { error.raise("slot", "") })
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

component Card(label string) node {
    var caught = ""

    vbox {
        boundary(@error(e) { caught = e.message }) {
            text(value="{label} {caught}")
            effect(@mount { error.raise("card", "") })
        }
    }
}

component inInstance node {
    var items = ["a"]

    vbox {
        for var it = items {
            Card(label=it)
        }
    }
}

func testUnderIf(t Test, c underIf) {
    t.assert(c.caught == "if")
}

func testInSlot(t Test, c inSlot) {
    t.assert(c.caught == "slot")
    t.snapshot("slot")
}

func testInInstance(t Test, c inInstance) {
    t.snapshot("instance")
}

window {
    underIf
    inSlot
    inInstance
}
